computation:
SCENARIO RECONSTRUCTION (from the pre-change series' own arithmetic, checked against the export).
1. Ranks. Q cost 60 -> rank 5 of [40,45,50,55,60]. W cost 100 -> rank 5 of [60,70,80,90,100]. E 50 and R 100 are rank-flat. Q5+W5+E5+R3 = 18 points -> level 18.
2. Level-18 stats. Mana = 480 + 40*17*(0.7025+0.0175*17) = 480 + 680*1.0 = 1160.0. The series opens at 1760.0 -> 600 flat mana from the item set. Mana regen = 8 + 0.8*17*1.0 = 21.6 per 5s = 4.32/s with no item regen: the pre-change series' inter-cast drifts are 1.08/0.25s, 20.52/4.75s, 9.82/2.27s, 11.78/2.73s = 4.32/s throughout. Model confirmed.
3. Ability haste. W: 8 * 100/(100+AH) = 7.2727 -> AH = 10 from items. Q: rechargeRate 7 is affectedByCdr=false, but R's passive grants Dark Sphere ability haste [10,20,30]; at R rank 3 that is +30, so 7 * 100/(100+30+10) = 7*100/140 = 5.000 s exactly -- matching the pre-change Q epochs 0, 5, 10 to the digit. The scenario is fully pinned.
4. The scenario suffixes are Splinter-of-Wrath counts, not durations. The Transcendent thresholds in the cache are 40 (Q stocks a charge, max 2), 60 (W true damage), 80 (E), 100 (R execute), 120 (+15% AP). 60 and 120 both clear 40, so BOTH scenarios run Dark Sphere as a 2-charge ability; the two suffixes differ only in damage riders, never in cast identity or mana cost. That is why the two pre-change timelines are byte-identical, and why leaf 1 and leaf 2 resolve identically.
5. Dark Sphere schedule under the charge model. Charges are full at t=0 and the recharge period is the effective 5.000 s from step 3, so Dark Sphere is castable at t = 0, 0, 5, 10 -- four casts. The pre-change series carries only three (0, 5, 10): the second stocked charge was never spent. Restoring it inserts one row at index 1 and shifts every later row by one. The whole series, member by member:
   [0] Q Dark Sphere      ord 1  t=0.00   spends 60 mana
   [1] Q Dark Sphere      ord 2  t=0.00   spends 60 mana  <- second stocked charge, the disputed address
   [2] W Force of Will    ord 1  t=0.00   spends 100 mana
   [3] E Scatter the Weak ord 1  t=0.00   spends 50 mana
   [4] R Unleashed Power  ord 1  t=0.25   spends 100 mana
   [5] Q Dark Sphere      ord 3  t=5.00   spends 60 mana
   [6] W Force of Will    ord 2  t=7.27   spends 100 mana
   [7] Q Dark Sphere      ord 4  t=10.00  spends 60 mana
6. What a charged Dark Sphere spends. The charge is an AVAILABILITY gate, not a price. Syndra Q is tagged resource=MANA with cost [40,45,50,55,60] as a single unconditional modifier list; neither the Transcendent bonus text ('periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2') nor the ability notes (which only describe the sphere-icon HUD readout) exempt a charged cast from mana. The cache settles it across champions: all 13 MANA-resource charge abilities pay full mana per charge spent, and the wiki marks the three abilities whose per-cast resource IS the charge with resource=CHARGE, cost 1 (Ashe E, Gangplank E, Kled Q). Syndra Q is MANA, so every Dark Sphere cast in this series spends 60.0 mana at rank 5, the second charge included.
CONCLUSION. cast_timeline[1] is Dark Sphere ordinal 2 spending 60.0 mana. 100.0 prices Force of Will, which the corrected series holds at index 2, not index 1 -- right number, wrong cast. 0.0 names the right cast but prices it as free, which no charge ability in the cache is. Both sides are wrong at that address. cast_timeline[6] is Force of Will ordinal 2 at t=7.27: with exactly one row inserted at index 1, pre-change index 5 (slot W) lands on index 6, so slot 'W' is correct and 'Q' is the un-shifted old address.
